items.question: According to this retailer's return policy, within how many days will a refund be credited to a card, bank account, PayPal or Tabby account after a courier pick-up or online return?
items.fact: Card, bank, PayPal or Tabby refunds credited within 4-15 days.

items.question: Can a customer return furniture by wrapping it and bringing it to any store with their invoice, according to this retailer's return policy?
items.gold: No, furniture is excluded from the wrap-and-bring-to-store return option.
items.fact: Furniture excluded from in-store return wrapping option.
